title: Selecting a tab highlights the summary figures that tab feeds
refs: SV-8661 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 S5-R14 — selecting a tab highlights the summary figures it feeds; soft violet fill and ring; supersedes the amber design-review colour)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Work In Progress report is open, showing the summary strip and the four line-state tabs, with money in every bucket.
steps:
1. Note the summary strip figures and which tab is active on arrival.
2. Click the "Approved - Not Started" tab and look at the summary figures.
3. Click each of the other tabs in turn ("Approved - Partially Completed", "Completed", "Estimates") and look at the summary figures each time.
expected:
1. Selecting a line-state tab highlights the summary figure(s) that make up that tab's bucket — the highlight is on the figure, not on the tab itself.
2. The mapping is: the "Approved - partially completed" tab highlights both open-work-order figures (Completed Work on Open Work Orders and Remaining Work on Open Work Orders); the "Approved - not started" tab highlights Work Orders Not Started; the "Completed" tab highlights Work Orders Ready to Invoice; the "Estimates" tab highlights Estimates.
3. Only the selected tab's figure(s) are highlighted at any one time; switching tabs moves the highlight to the new tab's figure(s).
4. The highlight is a soft violet fill and ring on the figure.
5. The active tab itself shows in the accent colour at a bolder weight.

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S5-R14), read on 26 August 2026.
This case previously asserted the glow appeared on the active TAB element itself; the 13 August 2026 design review (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/42c35f46-2796-467e-9723-7daa5385446e) placed it behind the composing summary figures instead, and specification version 28 now states the requirement directly, so we take the specification as prevailing.
The design review described the colour as amber and this case previously carried that as an open design-vs-build question. Specification version 28 states the highlight is a soft violet fill and ring, which resolves the question in favour of violet — there is no longer a colour discrepancy to raise.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/20/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
